function: Channel estimation for OTFS: an LSTM interpolates the time-frequency channel from preamble and pilots and compensates HPA nonlinearity (p. 3, 7)
system: Single link, antenna count not stated, no RIS; OTFS with M=64 subcarriers, N=14 symbols; 5.9 GHz carrier, 10 MHz bandwidth; HPA nonlinearity (p. 9)
method: LSTM followed by a shallow NN, supervised training with Adam, learning rate 0.001, MSE against the perfect channel, 500 epochs (p. 8, 9)
data_channel: Simulated ITU-T Vehicular-A doubly selective channel, v=300 km/h; 10,000 channel realizations, 80% training, 20% testing; 3GPP-fitted polynomial HPA model (p. 4, 8, 9)
test_conditions: Same Vehicular-A channel, v=300 km/h, for training and testing; random 20% held out; SNR sweep; QPSK at IBO 2 dB, 16-QAM at IBO 4 dB (p. 8, 9)
baselines: Classical: threshold estimator TCE [6] and correlation estimator CCE [7] with DD-domain pilots; perfect-CSI reference; no learned baseline (p. 9)
metrics: BER, throughput, PAPR (CCDF), and computational complexity order (p. 9-12)
complexity: Order O(Mon^2 + Mp^2 + Mon*Mp + Md*N); LSTM operations 4*chi^2+4*chi*I+3*chi, NN 60*Mon; compared with TCE and CCE in Table III (p. 12)
q1_support: p. 9: "considering the ITU-T Vehicular-A [36] with speed v = 300 km/h"
q2_support: p. 8: "randomly selecting 80% and 20%, respectively, from a pool of 10,000 distinct realizations of the vehicular channel". Not met: testing uses a held-out part of the same Vehicular-A data; only SNR, IBO, modulation and frame size N are varied, and no unseen scenario or adaptation is stated.
q3_support: p. 9: "We compare our proposal with the benchmark methods TCE [6] and CCE [7]". Not met: both are classical DD-domain estimators; the legends of Figs. 6-9 (p. 10) show only perfect CSI, TCE, CCE and LS-LSTM-NN, so no earlier learned estimator is compared.
q4_support: p. 12: "Table III summarizes the complexity order required for each method compared in this paper"
q5_support: p. 9: "the codes used for the simulated results can be downloaded at [34]". Reference [34] on p. 13 gives the GitHub link.
notes: Included as area 4 (OTFS channel estimation at 300 km/h): the estimation is done in the TF domain, and the order rule puts area 4 before 2. HPA nonlinearity and PAPR are evaluated, but the learned function is channel estimation and the paper says PAPR reduction is not its focus (p. 3). q1 is marked met on the ITU Vehicular-A model, cited to ETSI TS 136 104 (ref. [36], p. 13), a standardized model other than TR 38.901; the reviewer should confirm. Antenna count is not stated; Fig. 1 (p. 5) shows one transmit and one receive chain. The HAL cover page prints the DOI 10.1109/TVT.2024.3406192 (p. 1), which matches. Pages are file pages; the paper itself starts on p. 2 after the HAL cover page.
